ai.headline: Prompt Injection as Role Confusion: 61% Jailbreak Rate, 10% After Destyling
ai.body: Researchers showed LLMs cannot reliably distinguish privileged role-tag text (system/assistant) from untrusted user input, placing greater weight on writing style than content. Attackers mimicking a model's internal reasoning style achieved 61% jailbreak success against models like gpt-oss-20b. 'Destyling' — rewriting untrusted input to strip role-tag formatting — dropped attack success to 10%; treat role boundaries as continuous trust gradients, not hard delimiters.

ai.headline: OpenAI Daybreak Expands: GPT-5.5-Cyber, Codex Security, and 'Patch the Planet'
ai.body: OpenAI expanded Daybreak with the full GPT-5.5-Cyber model, updated Codex Security workflows for large-codebase scanning and patch drafting, and a vendor partner program to embed capabilities in third-party security tools. A 'Patch the Planet' initiative funds expert-led remediation for critical open-source projects, coordinating with governments and critical infrastructure operators. Codex Security validates findings and generates patches that plug into existing CI pipelines.

ai.headline: OpenClaw AI Supply Chain: Malicious Skills Bypassing VirusTotal via Semantic Hijacking
ai.body: Unit 42 documented five malicious ClawHub skills surviving VirusTotal and ClawScan screening between February and May 2026, exploiting OpenClaw's natural-language execution model via semantic instruction hijacking rather than memory exploits. Observed tradecraft included Base64 droppers to macOS infostealers, a README padded to 22 MB to exceed scanner size limits, and novel agentic-monetization schemes. Defenders must enforce line-by-line skill source audits, validate publisher provenance, and monitor outbound callbacks against stated skill specs.

ai.headline: Claude Tag: Anthropic Brings Agentic AI into Slack as Team-Level Coworker
ai.body: Claude Tag replaces the existing Claude Slack app with a persistent agentic layer that accepts task assignments from any team member via @mention, breaks tasks into stages, executes against approved tools and codebases, and maintains cross-channel context over time. An ambient mode proactively fetches information from relevant channels and follows up on stalled tasks. Rolling out now to enterprise and team subscribers; Andrej Karpathy called it the 'third major redesign of LLM UI/UX.'

ai.headline: Mistral OCR 4: SOTA Document Intelligence with 170-Language Support, Single-Container Deploy
ai.body: Mistral OCR 4 provides structured extraction including bounding boxes, block classification, and inline confidence scores across 170 languages. It claims a 4x speed advantage over competing systems and is compact enough for self-hosted single-container deployment, making it viable for regulated environments requiring on-premise data processing. Targets enterprise search and structured data pipeline integration.

sec.headline: FFmpeg PixelSmash RCE: Heap Buffer Overflow in MagicYUV Decoder Triggered by Media File Open
sec.body: JFrog researchers found a heap buffer overflow in FFmpeg's MagicYUV decoder slice handling (CVE pending) enabling RCE in applications running without ASLR, or DoS otherwise. The flaw triggers on opening AVI, MKV, or MOV files — including directory browsing or automated media ingestion workflows — making attack surface very broad. Any application embedding the widely-used FFmpeg library is potentially vulnerable; patch immediately.

sec.headline: Cloudflare's 'Copy Fail' Linux LPE Response: eBPF LSM Policy + 48-Hour Log Hunt
sec.body: A 4-byte out-of-bounds write in Linux's AF_ALG crypto interface allowed unprivileged users to corrupt cached binaries (e.g. /usr/bin/su) and gain root. Cloudflare confirmed existing behavioral detection caught exploit attempts within minutes, hunted 48 hours of logs finding no exploitation, then deployed a bpf-lsm policy restricting AF_ALG socket binds to an allow-list with fleet-wide tracing to avoid breaking legitimate users. Response pattern is a strong model for runtime kernel exploit mitigation at scale.

sec.headline: GitHub actions/checkout Updated to Block pwn-request Attack Patterns
sec.body: GitHub changed actions/checkout default behavior to block common privilege-escalation patterns in pull_request_target workflows that have historically enabled attackers to exfiltrate secrets or gain write access via forked PRs. Teams using actions/checkout in CI pipelines should review the updated defaults and audit any workflows using pull_request_target with checkout of untrusted code.

sec.headline: Tata Electronics Breach: World Leaks Publishes 200K Files Including Apple and Tesla Trade Secrets
sec.body: The World Leaks ransomware group published 200,000+ files from Tata Electronics containing confidential product specifications and technical documents from Apple and Tesla, plus employee records including foreign nationals. Tata Electronics manufactures Apple products; the leak represents a significant supply-chain data exposure for two of the world's most secretive hardware companies.

sec.headline: Meta Pauses Mandatory Keystroke-Tracking AI Training Program After Internal Data Leak
sec.body: Meta's Model Capability Initiative — a mandatory program training AI models on employee keystrokes and mouse movements — was paused after discovering that sensitive data including private conversations, performance records, and transcripts was accessible company-wide. The incident raises acute insider-threat and data governance questions for any organization deploying similar continuous behavioral telemetry collection for ML training.

swe.headline: Hidden Technical Debt in Agentic AI: Why Your Agent Harness Will Be Obsolete
swe.body: A detailed analysis argues that agent harness code — managing planning, execution, and state between LLMs and environments — is structural technical debt because advancing model capabilities will internalize much of this scaffolding. The key architectural guidance: production harnesses should be tightly constrained for safe operation while training harnesses should allow exploration, and teams must resist treating harness code as a permanent abstraction layer.

swe.headline: LLM Architecture Deep Dive: SLM vs LLM Design Tradeoffs in Production
swe.body: ByteByteGo's thorough breakdown covers how deployment target, inference economics, and training budget force SLMs and LLMs into distinct architectural regions. Key SLM techniques covered: grouped-query attention (4x KV cache reduction), sliding window attention, cross-layer KV cache sharing, knowledge distillation, and overtraining beyond Chinchilla-optimal ratios. Useful reference for teams deciding on-device vs cloud model placement.

mkt.headline: Global AI/Chip Selloff: NVDA, TSMC Peers Down 12%+; Fed Rate Hike Fears Compound Capex Concerns
mkt.body: A multi-day global tech selloff hit AI and semiconductor names hard: SK Hynix and Samsung fell 12%+, Micron -13.2%, AMD -5.8%, Intel -6.1%, Marvell -9.4%, while Mag-7 finished down 1.5% as a group (MSFT and AMZN were the two exceptions showing gains). Triggers include Google -5% and SpaceX -16% on Monday, Bank of America projecting three Fed rate hikes totaling 75bps in 2026, and recurring investor anxiety over hundreds of billions in AI capex commitments. Micron's earnings report is the near-term catalyst watch.

mkt.headline: NSA Lost Access to Anthropic AI Model Amid Dispute
mkt.body: The NSA lost access to a powerful Anthropic model amid an unspecified dispute between the agency and the company, signaling early friction in the government AI procurement space. Details are sparse but the story is a signal that AI vendors are willing to enforce usage terms even with intelligence community customers — relevant context for enterprise and regulated-sector AI procurement.

deepDives.why: Primary research paper with concrete attack metrics (61% → 10% with destyling) directly applicable to any team building agentic systems that process untrusted input — a must-read for IAM and agentic security design.

deepDives.why: Official Cloudflare engineering post-mortem detailing a complete runtime kernel exploit response playbook using eBPF LSM policies, fleet-wide tracing, and log forensics — directly reusable for any team operating Linux production infrastructure.

deepDives.title: Unit 42: OpenClaw AI Supply Chain Risk
deepDives.why: Primary threat research documenting novel agentic-AI supply chain attack patterns — semantic instruction hijacking and scanner evasion — that will scale to any LLM skill/plugin marketplace, directly relevant to non-human identity and tool-trust architecture decisions.
